title: What If a Nuclear Bomb Exploded in Space? One Already Did
subject: space nuclear explosion

scenes.text: What if a nuclear bomb exploded in space? In 1962 one did, and Hawaii's lights went out.
Starfish Prime was a 1.4 megaton bomb, set off 400 kilometers above the Pacific.
Nothing happened on the ground there. But 1,500 kilometers away in Hawaii, hundreds of streetlights failed.
Phone service dropped across the islands too. The pulse hit electronics from space.
The blast also filled space with radiation. At least six satellites were damaged and eventually failed.
Auroras glowed for thousands of kilometers, and the radiation belts lasted for months.
